sentences.en: I think it's time for me to sharpen my pencil.
sentences.zh: 我觉得该把铅笔削尖了。

sentences.en: This is the first time I've ever sharpened my knives.
I cannot sharpen this knife. It's too old and rusted.
sentences.zh: 这把刀太旧也生锈了，没法磨刀。

senses.zh: 使锐利,使敏捷,加重,削尖vi.尖锐,变锋利

mnemonic: 词根记忆：sharp（锋利的）+en（使…）→使锋利的→削尖
